user_query: I want to check the validity of several email addresses for my friends.

TaskList.description: Verify if the email addresses 'friend1@gmail.com', 'friend2@yahoo.com', and 'friend3@hotmail.com' are deliverable using the Emails Verifier API.
Determine if the email 'friend4@example.com' is a valid address using the Email Address Validator API and provide the reason for its validation status.
Consolidate the verification results from the Emails Verifier API and the Email Address Validator API.
